context: a single passage from a letter by J. D. Hooker, which you are answering on its own
exchanges: Many thanks for mentioning Herberts paper, I have it in my eye all along, it is as you say a good deal to the purpose. Another year I should like much to work a little at your chalk & clay floras but have no idea of what a summer may bring forth: if Sir H. will not let me work the thing as any Botanist would advise, I should throw it up; though this I have never hinted to any one: but Sir. H. though a kind, good man, has no system of his own & cannot bear Forbes & my working with books.
I am extremely glad you have not given up thoughts of examining our Flora; I shd. like beyond all things going part of the way on your expeditions.
